facts.fact: The Uganda Judiciary reports that Namibia is preparing to roll out its own Integrated Electronic Case Management System (IECMS), and a 15-member Namibian delegation benchmarked Uganda's ECCMIS in May 2025.

The Judiciary of Uganda reports that its Electronic Court Case Management Information System (ECCMIS) is implemented, with progress in automating lower courts and a tailored version in the Anti-Corruption Division.

systems.system: Electronic Court Case Management Information System (ECCMIS)
